breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error. It explicitly states 'using the parallel-flow LMTD expression' and defines ΔT1 = Th,in − Tc,in and ΔT2 = Th,out − Tc,out, which are the parallel-flow temperature differences. The ground truth requires counterflow definitions: ΔT1 = Th,in − Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out − Tc,in. The inconsistency was not resolved.
